name: Oscar Fairplay
original_name: オスカー・フェアプレイ
source:
A gentleman who works as a city banker. He witnessed the incident from his seat on the roof deck of the omnibus.

[From in-game profile]

[spoiler]Serves as the foreman for the trials of Soseki Natsume.[/spoiler]
